text: Stepping through the bright, angular corridors, I feel a sharp sense of anticipation and curiosity. The modern glass walls evoke clarity and transparency, while the adjacent R+D exhibition hints at a spirit of inquiry and innovation. Being here, I am aware of the convergence between creativity and knowledge, which inspires me to reflect on how environments shape our thoughts, questions, and connections. There is an undercurrent of excitement—like I am on the cusp of discovery.
